title: Review this workspace's Learnings.md entries
why: An entry only retires when a finding filed against it has been verified into a skill or rejected by a person. The entries no proposal has ever linked are exactly the ones nothing is watching, and they can only be judged by reading them.

title: Check whether person notes need re-homing
why: An older engine's memory curation ran once for the whole install with one workspace as its write target, so work contacts landed in that workspace's People/ folder. The routing bug is fixed, but the backlog it produced is still on disk, and moving a note means moving every reference to it. This install has more than one workspace and has never recorded a re-homing — which is a receipt check, not a scan, so nothing here knows yet whether anything is actually misfiled.
